subject: SSO redirect loop after certificate rotation
summary: SAML login looped back to the sign-in page.
steps: Confirm the identity provider rotated its signing certificate
Upload the new certificate in the SSO settings
Ask one user to sign in again and confirm
resolution: Updated the SAML certificate; logins recovered.

subject: Charged for unused seats
summary: Customer billed for more seats than active members.
steps: Compare billed seats with active workspace members
Create a refund request for the difference
Reduce the seat count before the next renewal
resolution: Refund approved for the unused seats and seat count reduced.

subject: HTTP 429 on scheduled job
summary: A batch job exceeded the per-minute rate limit.
steps: Check the plan API rate limit
Add backoff and spread requests over the minute
Consider a plan upgrade for a higher limit
resolution: Customer added backoff and the job stayed under the limit.

subject: Uploads blocked at quota
summary: Workspace storage hit the plan quota.
steps: Check used storage against the quota
Empty the trash, which still counts toward usage
Archive old folders or upgrade the plan
resolution: Customer emptied the trash and archived old folders.

subject: External sharing disabled
summary: Member could not share outside the workspace.
steps: Check the workspace external sharing policy
Confirm the member role allows sharing
Ask an admin to enable external sharing for the folder
resolution: Admin enabled external sharing for that folder.

subject: Slack notifications stopped
steps: Post a test update to the channel
